$comment: Written by Capsule.Build.Schemas.FormatSchemas, for the files Capsule.Build.Strings.StringFile reads.
title: Capsule string table
description: One language's texts, named <tag>.strings.json for its BCP 47 tag. Each key maps to a text, a group of more keys, or a list of texts, and a key path joins the names with '.'.

$schema.description: The URL of this file's JSON Schema, which gives an editor completion and hover. The build ignores its value.

oneOf.description: A text. {name} fills an argument, at most three names to a text, and '{' and '}' are literal braces. {n, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}} picks a form by an integer argument, and # shows it. \n breaks the line.
A list of texts in order, each keyed by its position. Every language gives the source language's count.
